{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pulls/870","id":5006729191,"node_id":"PR_kwDOPX15Ts8AAAABKmyf5w","html_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/870","diff_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/870.diff","patch_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/870.patch","issue_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/issues/870","commits_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pulls/870/commits","review_comments_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pulls/870/comments","review_comment_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pulls/comments{/number}","comments_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/issues/870/comments","statuses_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/statuses/8499d71207803de7dfa6f0b68986d897136fdbf1","number":870,"state":"open","locked":false,"title":"mcp: record the calls the bridge refuses (unknown tool names, gate denials)","user":{"login":"IanFrelinger","id":16062048,"node_id":"MDQ6VXNlcjE2MDYyMDQ4","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/16062048?v=4","gravatar_id":"","url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger","html_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger","followers_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/followers","following_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/following{/other_user}","gists_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"body":" ## Summary Finding **M1** from the adversarial audit of the MCP brick host (#856, #858). The host promises "one record per brick call (refusals included)". But `AshlarMcpToolBridge` refuses two kinds of call before any contributor sees them, so neither was recorded and both reached only stderr: - a tool name the catalog does not list. This includes a registered brick that is not allowlisted (`github_pr-status` when only `github.blockers` is exposed), the canonical id (`github.blockers`), case and whitespace variants, and so on; - a call the `IMcpInvocationGate` denies. Observed over stdio: ten unknown-name calls produced zero records. The contributor's own "Brick '…' is not exposed" refusal cannot be reached over MCP for the same reason. The protocol error also echoed the caller's name whole: 100 KB in, 100 KB out in the error and in the log line. ## Changes - New port `IMcpRefusalAuditor` (Ashlar.Mcp.Server). The bridge calls it for both refusals, and the caller sees its returned text: the protocol error message, or the denial `isError` text with the `auditId` appended. If the record fails, the call is still refused and the message says it is unaudited. With no auditor registered, behaviour is unchanged. - `BrickMcpToolContributor` implements it. It writes an `MCP_BRICK_INVOKED` record with outcome `refused`: - `agentName` is the canonical id for a denial, or `mcp.unknown-tool` for an unlisted name; - the name as sent is stored as `requestedToolSha256`, plus `requestedTool` in printable form (64 characters, `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]`, anything else replaced by `_`); - the arguments are stored only as a hash. `AddAshlarMcpBricks` registers the same instance as both contributor and auditor. - A caller-sent name is cut to 64 characters, with control characters replaced, before it goes into a log line or the error. - Host README: documents the record shape, and the part this does not cover. A `tools/call` whose `arguments` is not a JSON object, or a malformed frame, is rejected inside the MCP SDK (`-32603` / `-32700`) before Ashlar code runs, so it is still not recorded. ## Testing - `scripts/test-in-container.sh --project src/Ashlar.Mcp.Server.Tests/... --framework net8.0 --filter FullyQualifiedName~Ashlar.Mcp`: 61/61. - New tests: - bridge: unknown tool recorded, with the id in the error; gate denial recorded with the canonical id; a failed record still refuses; an oversized name is cut in the error but reaches the auditor whole; - contributor: record fields (printable name, hashes, no argument values); - end-to-end: a real MCP client calling a registered-but-unlisted brick gets a protocol error whose `auditId` is on the record, and the brick never runs. - Mutation checks (`scripts/mutation-check.sh`): - `bridge-ignores-auditor`: **KILLED** red=failed:5/61 green=passed:61/61. - `auditor-not-registered`: **KILLED** red=failed:1/61 green=passed:61/61. - `name-not-cut`: **KILLED** red=failed:1/61 green=passed:61/61. Suggested CHANGELOG line: *Fixed: the MCP brick host records calls to tools it does not list and calls its policy gate denies, and tells the caller the auditId.* Touches records/docs: `src/Ashlar.Mcp.Server.Host/README.md` (What a call returns, Audit records), `docs/knowledge-graph.*`. Expect trivial conflicts with #868 and #869 (`AddAshlarMcpBricks`, the README, the knowledge graph): keep both sides. With #868, the singleton registration here should construct `ConfirmedBarrierAuditLog` instead of `StructuredBarrierAuditLog`. ## Checklist - [x] Not a versioned release — skip - [x] Documentation updated
